messages.subject: Adding controls to leaflet-shiny popups
parts:
I am working on an app that make heavy use of leaflet-shiny. Currently I have the popups working well, but I would like to add a control and maybe a conditional panel to a popup - that way the user could get more information by using a check box, for example. Is this possible? If so how?

JP
